replies.author: User
replies.text:
Blueprint me debería permitir:
- CRUD also Edit boards.
- Agruparlos (analizar mejores opciones para esto y proponerme en chat).
- Crear mis propios bocetos a mano (integrado, nada de flujos separados).

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done in 4.1 to 4.7: New board (empty, a copy, or an imported 2.x board), each board's menu with Rename, Duplicate, Move to folder and Delete, Delete with confirmation, folders like Void's (the option chosen in chat), search with filters, editing the board in place with its tools, and hand sketches drawn on the same board.

replies.author: User
replies.text: Checkbox: Send to agent. On by default. Remains the same value until changed.

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. The comment composer of Blueprint and Void has Send to agent, on by default and kept at the value it is left at; 4.9 shows it on, 4.12 shows it turned off.

replies.author: User
replies.text:
Features expected:
* CRUD.
* Edit/Rename.
* Search bar
* Collapsable groups
* Filters

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. Void uses the same library as Blueprint: create, rename in place, delete, search, collapsible folders and filters (5.1 and 5.2; the menu and the filters are drawn on 4.2 and 4.4).

replies.author: User
replies.text: Falta la parte de edit. Con funciones de Void editor

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done. 5.3 Editing with Void's format bar over the selection and continuous saving, 5.4 Find and replace, 5.5 Source. A suggestion can be edited (5.6) and an old one offers Edit passage (5.7).
